info.title: Scheme Calculator - Dealer scheme status API
info.description:
POST {dealer_code, scheme_tags} returns the stored scheme status of one dealer: slabs with LOCKED / UNLOCKED, gift and CN, for Festive Bonanza (FB-PAN, FB-TNHPJK) and Star Points (SP-Q3). Server-to-server only (no CORS).

**Try it:** select a server, click **Authorize** and enter your client_id and client_secret (OAuth2 client credentials; Local: local-client / local-test-secret). Swagger gets a Bearer token from POST /api/v1/auth/token and sends it on every call. Then click **Try it out** on the request and select an example. Examples named `invalid_*` must return 400; the other examples return 200.

Full guide: docs/API_GUIDE.md in the repository.

post.description: Returns one SchemeStatus for each requested tag, in request order. A child dealer code returns the parent's result (dealer_code in the response is the parent code). Order of checks: 503 API_DISABLED, 429 (per IP), 413 (declared Content-Length), 401 / 403 (token), 429 (per client), 400 INVALID_REQUEST / 413 (streamed body), response cache, 400 UNKNOWN_SCHEME_TAG, 404, 200.

schemes.reason: Dealer region is not in the scope of this scheme.

400.description: Request not valid, or unknown scheme tag. The UNKNOWN_SCHEME_TAG message names the first unknown tag only when the tag matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$. Otherwise the message is "A scheme tag does not exist." (the input is never repeated). With the cache on, UNKNOWN_SCHEME_TAG is cached and has X-Cache. INVALID_REQUEST is not cached and has no X-Cache.

error.message: scheme_tags must have 10 items or fewer.
scheme_tags must be unique. FB-PAN is in the list more than once.
Scheme tag ABC9 does not exist.

403.description: Valid token without the schemes:read scope.

429.description: Rate limit used: per client IP (RATE_LIMIT_PER_SECOND, default 2,500 a second) or per client_id (API_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE, default 1,00,000 a minute).

error.message: Too many requests. Wait and try again.

500.description: Unexpected server error. No detail in the body.

get.description: TRACE and other methods that are not GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or OPTIONS also get 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with Allow: POST, from the method guard (src/server/method-guard.ts).

post.summary: Get an access token (OAuth2 client credentials)
post.description: Exchange client_id and client_secret for a Bearer token valid for 1 hour. Send grant_type=client_credentials form-encoded (RFC 6749) or as a JSON object of strings, with the client credentials in HTTP Basic auth or as client_id and client_secret in the body (not both). Reuse the token until it expires. This endpoint has its own, much lower, rate limit (TOKEN_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE per client IP, default 30). Errors use the RFC 6749 format.

value.error_description: A parameter was sent more than once
The request body must be 8192 bytes or smaller.

429.description: Too many token requests from this IP. Reuse the token.

value.error_description: Too many requests. Wait and try again.

503.description: API disabled on this server (auth settings refused).

value.error_description: The API is not enabled on this server.

get.summary: Not allowed (also HEAD, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)
Health probe (no authentication, no dealer data, never rate limited)
get.description: Readiness probe: checks the database. 200 only when the server and the database work; 503 when the database does not answer. data_as_of is kept for 15 s. HEAD on the same path gives the same status with no body (for load balancers).

RequestId.description: Request ID for support. Also in the server log.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before the next try.

WWWAuthenticateBasic.description: Only when the request sent an Authorization header (HTTP Basic client authentication, RFC 6749 section 5.2). With client_id and client_secret in the body, a 401 has no challenge, so a browser opens no sign-in dialog.

XCache.description: Only when the response cache is on (CACHE_ENABLED=true and REDIS_URL set). HIT: from Redis. MISS: from the database, now cached. BYPASS: Redis not available, answered from the database.

destination.description: Trip destination of the rule (added 22-10-2026; missing in results stored before the next engine run).

key.description: Read by key, not by position. See docs/api-contract.md 5.3.

RewardChoice.description: The dealer's saved reward choice for the scheme.

choice.description: GIFT = the slab gift (gold voucher or trip). CN = the slab CN alternative.

destination.description: Star Points: destination of the extra tickets above the top slab. Only for a dealer in Slab 7. Null = not chosen or not applicable.

source.description: Where the choice came from: ADMIN (one choice entered on the admin dealer page), UPLOAD (admin file upload), API (this API), DEMO (test data).

chosen_by.description: Admin-area user name, or chosen_by of the API.

reward_choice.description: IN_SCHEME only. The saved reward choice. Null = not chosen.

lock_status.description: UNLOCKED only for the slab that the dealer is in (current_slab_no). All other slabs, also the lower slabs, are LOCKED.

dealer_code.description: Dealer code. Spaces at the start and the end are removed.

scheme_tags.description: Active scheme tags, case-sensitive. Items unique after trimming. The response keeps this order.

dealer_code.description: Parent code when the requested code is a child dealer.

data_as_of.description: Time of the data load (IST offset +05:30).

schemes.description: One item for each requested tag, in request order.

client_id.description: Leave out when you send HTTP Basic auth.

client_secret.description: Leave out when you send HTTP Basic auth.

scope.description: Blank = all scopes that the client may use. Or a space-separated list: schemes:read, choices:write (choices:write only for clients in AUTH_WRITE_CLIENTS).

access_token.description: JWT (HS256). Send it as Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.

scope.description: Granted scopes, space-separated: schemes:read, and choices:write for a client in AUTH_WRITE_CLIENTS.

OAuth2ClientCredentials.description: Get a token from POST /api/v1/auth/token with your client_id and client_secret, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 1 hour (JWT_TTL_SECONDS). Reuse one until it expires.

scopes.choices:write: Save the dealer's reward choice (only clients in AUTH_WRITE_CLIENTS)
